description: AWS microwave sounder (RTTOV platform AWS, satellite id 1). The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.
short_description: AWS microwave sounder channel SRFs (EUMETSAT NWP SAF, for RTTOV)
facility_description: RTTOV platform AWS (EUMETSAT NWP SAF list of supported platforms).

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'SRF data in dbm and GHz. Obtained 05/06/2024 from MWS/AWS SAG' Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
